findings.basis: The preceding paragraph already identifies the linked files as the default configurations supplied on first startup. The following sentence adds the useful point that users can customize them; this sentence adds no distinct configuration behavior or instruction.
findings.diagnosis: Repeats the explanation of the default configuration without advancing the setup guidance.
findings.quote: It sets all of the default configuration to run Nushell.

findings.basis: The showcase link usefully directs readers to blog posts and technical videos, but the clauses about posts having been written and topics having been presented do not distinguish the resources or help readers choose them.
findings.diagnosis: Layers unnecessary relative clauses onto a simple description of the showcase repository's contents.
findings.quote:
off informative blog posts that have been written about Nushell along with videos that highlight technical
topics that have been presented.

findings.basis: The Goals introduction says new features are checked against these goals. Unlike the neighboring goals about platform compatibility and mutable state, this item supplies no identifiable criterion. The pipeline examples demonstrate data processing, but do not define the expected usability standard.
findings.diagnosis: Invokes an undefined standard of modern usability, leaving readers unable to tell what workflow or tool qualities this design goal requires.
findings.quote: Nu's workflow and tools should have the usability expected of modern software in 2022 (and beyond).
